verdict.rationale: Runpod has a public pricing page (runpod.io/pricing) referenced in docs, and per-second billing info exists for Pods and Serverless, implying published rates without sales contact. However, the evidence never shows an explicit per-GPU-hour price table for every GPU type, only general mentions like 'Simple pricing plans' and billing mechanics. Missing for 10: a direct citation of a full per-GPU rate table, confirmation that all GPU types (not just some) are listed, and independent/community corroboration that the pricing page is complete and sales-free.
